name: dsh-session-title-regenerate
description: Regenerate a session title with the model at the LOWEST reasoning tier: summarize all of the session's user questions (UTF-8 truncated) through ctx.llm with reasoningEffort 'off' + purpose 'session-title' (the DeepSeek adapter additionally forces thinking:disabled), then commit via sessionTitle.rename so the list updates instantly. Triggered from the session-header action button and from a DOM-injected '重新生成标题' item in the sidebar session-row '...' menu (core ui-workspace hard-codes that menu with no extension slot, so the item is injected at the DOM level like @huanlin/dsh-plugin-session-delete does). Host registers the /regenerate-title command; the client triggers it through remote.commands.execute, a core Remote whose agent lookup auto-resumes non-open sessions.
